# Copilot instructions: Tax App modernization demo

Fictional demo of upgrading a .NET Framework 4.8 MVC app to .NET 10. Illustrative tax figures, not tax advice. Synthetic data only.

[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) holds the operational rules and the verification loop. If the two disagree, AGENTS.md wins.

## Layout

- `legacy/` the before: ASP.NET MVC 5, .NET Framework 4.8, SDK-style projects, xUnit. Deliberately legacy.
- `modern/` the prebaked after: ASP.NET Core MVC, .NET 10, xUnit and in-memory HTTP tests.
- `tools/LegacyHost/` dev-only host that runs the legacy System.Web site without IIS.
- `scripts/` the contract, compare, workspace, drift and VS Code checks. `go.ps1` runs them.
- `legacy/TaxApp.Tests/Golden/tax-vectors.json` the golden master, generated by `scripts/golden/new_tax_vectors.py`.

## Commands

```powershell
./go.ps1 -Check                       # the gate (4 to 6 minutes)
dotnet test legacy/TaxApp.sln         # Windows only
dotnet test modern/TaxApp.sln
./go.ps1 -Run Legacy                  # http://localhost:8081
./go.ps1 -Run Modern                  # http://localhost:5081
```

## Conventions

- **Money is `decimal`**, rounded per component with `MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero`.
- The public contract is stable: URLs, form field names, `data-testid`/`data-value` attributes, PascalCase JSON, the
  `App_Data/deductions.json` format, `App_Data` never under `wwwroot`.
- Views carry `data-testid` and `data-value` hooks so machine checks read figures without parsing prose.
- Comments explain why, not what. Cite the reason when code exists for a legacy quirk.
- Tests read the shared golden master instead of hard-coding expectations.
- VS Code tasks are `"type": "process"` so `scripts/Test-VsCodeConfig.ps1` can execute them exactly as written.

## Non-negotiable

- Never edit expected values in the golden master or loosen the HTTP contract to make a change pass.
- Never present `modern/` as the Copilot upgrade agent's output.
- Do not modernize `legacy/`; it is the demo input. C# 7.3 in `.cs`, C# 5 in `.cshtml`.
- Report real command output. Do not claim a check passed unless you ran it.
